digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate and operator-attested completion evidence
propositions: Operator-attested describes evidence location (outside codebase with concrete attestation in ticket), not actor identity; agents may record truthful observed evidence
The [operator-attested] criterion tag must be added to checkpoint text before plan review to classify the evidence kind; late addition invalidates the signed plan attestation as stale-material
Evidence may be recorded as a ticket comment after plan review without invalidating the review, because comments are non-material to plan certification

Documentation clarification (ADR 0043 and plan-writing guide) is required to resolve conflicting guidance between plan-gate anti-tamper requirements and completion-remediation remediation instructions
